name: Exclusion Zone [UPD]
desc:
The apocalypse has arrived, and survival isn’t guaranteed. Every decision matters. One wrong move… and it’s all gone.

- Scavenge for loot to defend yourself
- Complete missions to get back to safety
- Face tougher challengers the longer you survive
- Die and you lose everything...
